deals.travelWindow: Dec 30 – Feb 2027 (JetBlue one-way $79 seen for Jan 5 and Jan 30)
deals.whyRanked: JetBlue $79 one-way seen within 24 h on its BOS page (RT est. ~2x; verify); National Mall and Rock Creek Park in town.
deals.soloWhy: Compact, Metro-connected, free Smithsonian museums and plenty of hostels and solo-friendly cafes.

highlights: Lincoln Memorial and MLK Memorial at dusk
Smithsonian museums (free): Air and Space, American History
itinerary: Day 1 — Fly into DCA, Metro to the Mall, monuments walk at sunset
Day 2 — Smithsonian morning, Eastern Market lunch, Capitol Hill stroll
Day 3 — C&O Canal towpath in Georgetown, depart
guide.gettingAround: DCA has its own Metro stop; the Metro plus walking covers everything, no car needed.
guide.stayArea: Dupont Circle or Capitol Hill for Metro access and walkable dining.

deals.travelWindow: Jan 12 – Feb 2027 (JetBlue one-way $91 for Jan 12; Southwest $100 for Jan 19)
deals.whyRanked: JetBlue $91 and Southwest $100 one-way seen within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); Wekiwa Springs and Canaveral Seashore within an hour.
deals.soloWhy: Great hub for springs and beaches with a rental car; the theme-park core is less solo-oriented.

highlights: Winter Park chain of lakes boat tour
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, Lake Eola and Thornton Park dinner
Day 2 — Blue Spring manatees, Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; parks and springs are not on transit.
guide.stayArea: Thornton Park or Winter Park for walkable cafes.

deals.whyRanked: JetBlue $99 one-way seen within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); no passport needed, El Yunque rainforest 1 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Old San Juan, easy rideshare, and warm in January.

highlights: San Juan National Historic Site: El Morro and San Cristóbal
El Yunque trails (La Mina Falls; reserve entry ahead)
Old San Juan blue cobblestone streets
itinerary: Day 1 — Old San Juan walk, El Morro at sunset
Day 2 — El Yunque morning hike, Luquillo kiosks lunch
Day 3 — Condado or Ocean Park beach, depart
guide.gettingAround: Walk Old San Juan; rent a car or book a tour for El Yunque.

itinerary: Day 1 — Riverside and Five Points, Riverwalk
Day 2 — Boneyard Beach at Big Talbot, Fernandina Beach

deals.whyRanked: $109 one-way seen on both Southwest and JetBlue within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); Cabrillo and Torrey Pines near the city.
deals.soloWhy: Mild winter weather, walkable neighborhoods, trolley and easy hostels.

Day 2 — Torrey Pines hike, La Jolla Cove
